independent_primary_evidence: https://api.docs.dealcloud.com/ - Requires tenant administrator to enable API capability on user groups.
https://developer.gladly.com/rest/ - API User role must be provisioned by instance admin; trial signups lack API key generator.
https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/get-started - Sandbox is self-serve; live production numbers require Meta Business Portfolio verification and template approvals.
https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/first-call/overview - Test accounts self-serve; production access requires approved 22-character Developer Token review.
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/overview - Ad management APIs require formal MDP developer application and ad account sponsorship.
https://developer-docs.amazon.com/sp-api/docs/connecting-to-the-selling-partner-api - Dual auth (LWA + AWS SigV4) and strict Restricted Data Role vetting for customer PII.
https://github.com/sherlock-project/sherlock - Open-source Python CLI; no official cloud-hosted HTTP REST service.
https://pitchbook.com/products/data/direct-data - Direct Data API exists but requires enterprise contract; exact pricing undisclosed publicly.
https://cloud.google.com/gemini/docs - Consumer NotebookLM has no public developer API; programmatic use restricted to Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise.
https://docs.consensus.app/ & https://mcp.consensus.app/mcp - Official vendor streamable MCP server available with self-serve free tier.
https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid-cli - Node.js npm package (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli) for command-line compilation; no hosted REST API.
https://docs.fanbasis.com - Rebranding to Commas; API surface is narrow, focusing on checkout SDK and webhooks.
